integrity: The analytical proof is self-contained. Exact arithmetic and linear-program testing only corroborate finite cases. Priority remains subject to historical-literature uncertainty.
scientific_limitations: The bound is sharp for best coordinate-deletion maps, not asserted for unrestricted Banach--Mazur distance; only finite-dimensional hyperplanes are treated; the historic minimal-projection paper was not readable in full.
title: Sharp coordinate-frame distortion from projection constants of finite-dimensional hyperplanes
